school: 两宋之交最伟大的女词人、词体独立地位的立法者与金石考据学的开创性合伙人：1084 年生于济南一个士大夫之家，父李格非为苏门'后四学士'之一，家藏书甚富；她少女时代即以《如梦令·昨夜雨疏风骤》名动京师，十八岁嫁太学生赵明诚，夫妇赌书泼茶、共同收藏金石书画，屏居青州十余年，命其室曰'归来堂'，自号易安居士，合著《金石录》千卷；靖康之变（1127）后南渡，金石书画在战乱中屡聚屡散，1129 年赵明诚病逝建康，她独自携残卷追随流亡朝廷辗转越州、台州、温州、金华，晚年定居临安；她作《金石录后序》追记三十年收藏聚散之痛，又著《词论》历评柳永、苏轼、黄庭坚等十六家，提出'词别是一家'——词须协音律、尚典雅、主情致，与诗分疆而治；词风以南渡为界：前期清丽明快，后期沉哀入骨，'寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚'十四叠字为千古绝唱；她证明：一个被排除在科举与仕途之外的女子，可以用一支笔同时赢得文学史与学术史——词的疆界由她划定，金石的苦难由她记账
historical_significance: 李清照（1084-约 1155），号易安居士，济南章丘人，父亲李格非是苏轼门下的学者与文士，母亲王氏亦知书能文；她在少女时代已以词名动京师，《如梦令·昨夜雨疏风骤》一出，'绿肥红瘦'四字为时人惊叹；1101 年十八岁嫁太学生赵明诚，赵父赵挺之后为宰相，夫妇初居汴京，后因新旧党争随赵家屏居青州乡里十余年，其间节衣缩食、倾尽俸禄搜求金石书画，建'归来堂'藏书之室，夫妇相对展玩咀嚼，'赌书泼茶'之乐传为千古佳话；赵明诚撰《金石录》，李清照参与校勘、题跋，实为学术合伙人；1127 年靖康之变，金兵入据中原，夫妇南渡，装载书册什物十五车，沿途屡遭兵火盗掠；1129 年赵明诚病逝于建康，李清照时年四十六，此后大病、所余文物又被人诬陷通敌、盗掠殆尽，她追随宋高宗流亡路线辗转两浙，绍兴年间定居临安，晚年曾呈《金石录》于朝；她的文学成就集中于词：前期写闺情与自然，明快清丽，后期写家国之痛与身世之悲，沉郁凄怆，《声声慢》'寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚'连下十四叠字，为词史绝调；她还写诗，《夏日绝句》'生当作人杰，死亦为鬼雄'慷慨激越，与词风判然两途——这正是她《词论》立场在创作上的体现：诗庄词媚，各有宪章；约 1134 年她作《词论》，历评柳永'词语尘下'、苏轼等'句读不葺之诗'、晏几道'苦无铺叙'等十六家之短，系统提出词'别是一家'的主张：协音律、尚典雅、重铺叙、主情致——这是中国文学史上第一篇系统的词体独立宣言；她另有《金石录后序》，以亲历者身份记述三十年收藏聚散，被视为宋代散文的名篇；约 1155 年病逝于临安——她身后留下的是：一座由她划定边界的词的王国，一部由她校定并作序传世的《金石录》，和一个证明了女性可以在学术与文学两界同时立名的样本
historical_significance_en: Li Qingzhao (1084-c. 1155), sobriquet Yi'an Jushi, was born in Zhangqiu near Jinan; her father Li Gefei was a scholar of Su Shi's circle and her mother also a woman of letters. In girlhood she astonished the capital with her lyrics: when 'Ru Meng Ling · Last night the rain was sparse and the wind sudden' appeared, the four characters 'lü fei hong shou' (green plump, red thin) drew general wonder. In 1101, at eighteen, she married Zhao Mingcheng, a student in the Imperial Academy. Ousted from the capital by the factional strife between reformers and conservatives, the couple withdrew to Qingzhou for over a decade, scrimping on clothes and food to spend everything on collecting bronzes, jades, calligraphy and paintings; they named their library the Hall of Return (Guilai Tang), and the pleasure of their 'gambling over books, spilling the tea' became proverbial. Zhao Mingcheng compiled the 'Jin Shi Lu' (Records on Metal and Stone), with Li Qingzhao as collaborator in collation and colophons — a genuine academic partnership. In 1127 the Jin armies broke through the north; the couple fled south with fifteen cartloads of books and objects, repeatedly harried by war, fire and theft. In 1129 Zhao Mingcheng died at Jiankang; she was forty-six. Thereafter illness, slander and further robbery stripped her of nearly all that remained; she followed the refugee court through the two Zhe routes and settled in Lin'an (Hangzhou), presenting the 'Jin Shi Lu' to the court in her last years. Her literary achievement centers on ci: the early lyrics on boudoir feeling and nature are bright and limpid; the later ones on national ruin and personal grief are deeply tragic — 'Sheng Sheng Man', opening with fourteen reduplicated characters 'xun xun mi mi, leng leng qing qing, qi qi can can qi qi', is the most famous line in the history of the genre. She also wrote shi poetry: 'Live as a hero among men, die as a hero among ghosts' from 'Summer Day Quatrain' is ardent and masculine in tone, a deliberate contrast with her ci — her creative practice enacting the position of her 'Ci Lun': shi is stately, ci is tender, each with its own charter. Around 1134 she wrote the 'Ci Lun' (On the Lyric), judging sixteen masters from Liu Yong ('vulgar diction') to Su Shi ('shi with no regard for its own punctuation') and Yan Jidao ('lacking narrative amplitude'), and systematically argued that ci 'is a family of its own' — conforming to musical law, esteeming elegance, valuing narrative amplitude and feeling: the first systematic declaration of the ci's independence in Chinese literary history. Her 'Hou Xu' (Afterword) to the 'Jin Shi Lu', an eyewitness account of thirty years of collecting and losing, is reckoned a masterpiece of Song prose. She died at Lin'an around 1155, leaving: a kingdom of ci whose borders she drew, a 'Jin Shi Lu' she collated and memorialized, and proof that a woman barred from examination and office could win standing in both literary and scholarly history.
unique_thinking: 李清照的独特处在于三重'在排除中立法'：第一，她敢于给文体立宪——当宋代文坛默认词只是'诗余'小道时，她写了《词论》逐家批评柳永、苏轼等十六位大家，提出'词别是一家'：协音律、尚典雅、主情致——一个没有科举功名的女子给整个文体划定了疆界；第二，她善于把生活做成学术——与赵明诚的婚姻不是传统的内助外业，而是'赌书泼茶'的学术合伙：共同搜求、校勘、题跋金石，她把闺房变成金石学的书房；第三，她敢于把丧失写成账本——南渡后典籍十五车散于兵火，《金石录后序》不是抒情的哀叹，而是一笔一笔的聚散账：何年所得、何年所失、失于何人之手——她证明：记录丧失本身就是一种学术，苦难最深的时刻也是 documentation 最有价值的时刻
unique_thinking_en: Li Qingzhao's singularity is a triple act of 'legislating from a position of exclusion'. First, she dared to give a genre its constitution: when the Song literary world assumed ci was merely 'the leftover of poetry', she wrote the 'Ci Lun', criticizing sixteen masters one by one — Liu Yong, Su Shi, Huang Tingjian among them — and argued that ci 'is a family of its own', conforming to musical law, esteeming elegance, valuing feeling — a woman without examination rank drew the borders of an entire genre. Second, she knew how to make life itself scholarship: her marriage to Zhao Mingcheng was not the traditional 'helpmeet within, career without' but an academic partnership of gambling over books and spilling tea — searching, collating and colophon-writing together, she turned the boudoir into a study of epigraphy. Third, she dared to write loss as a ledger: after the crossing south, fifteen cartloads of books scattered in war, and the 'Hou Xu' to the 'Jin Shi Lu' is not lyrical lamentation but an account kept item by item — what was acquired in which year, lost in which year, into whose hands it fell. She proved that recording loss is itself a form of scholarship, and that the moment of deepest suffering is precisely when documentation is most valuable.
civilization_zh: 两宋之交的济南、汴京与江南——一个书香门第的女儿，在少女时代便以一首《如梦令》惊动京师文坛，十八岁与太学生赵明诚成婚，赌书泼茶、共治金石，把婚姻过成学术合伙；靖康之变后她携十五车典籍南下逃亡，丈夫病逝、收藏散尽，她在国破家亡的晚年独自校定《金石录》并写下《词论》，为'词'这一文体争得独立地位——她证明：词别是一家，诗言志而词言情，两种文体各有各的宪法
civilization_en: Jinan, Bianjing (Kaifeng) and the Jiangnan of the Song dynasty's crossing — a daughter of a scholarly family whose one 'Ru Meng Ling' in girlhood astonished the capital's literary world; at eighteen she married the student Zhao Mingcheng, and with games of gambling over books and tea they made their marriage an academic partnership, compiling the 'Jin Shi Lu' (Records on Metal and Stone); after the Jingkang catastrophe she fled south with fifteen cartloads of books, her husband died, the collection scattered, and in her widowhood she collated the 'Jin Shi Lu' alone and wrote the 'Ci Lun', winning for the lyric (ci) its standing as an independent genre — proof that ci is a family of its own: poetry speaks of duty, ci speaks of feeling, and each form has its own constitution
roles_zh: 中国古代最伟大的女作家
roles_en: Collator and memorialist of the 'Jin Shi Lu'
Master of the wanyue (graceful) school of ci
Greatest woman writer of premodern China
key_works: 《金石录后序》（1132 前后，收藏聚散之账）

cross_references.description_zh: 李清照与张载同为'给领域立宪'的人：张载以《正蒙》为儒学重立本体论的宪法，李清照以《词论》为词体重立文体的宪法——两人都不在旧疆界内做注脚，而是重新划界——平行命题：一个领域的成熟，以它拥有自己的宪法为标志。
cross_references.description_en: Li Qingzhao and Zhang Zai are alike as constitution-givers of a domain: Zhang Zai's 'Zheng Meng' re-founded Confucian ontology's charter, Li Qingzhao's 'Ci Lun' re-founded the lyric's charter as a genre — neither wrote footnotes inside old borders; both redrew them. The parallel thesis: a field is mature when it owns its own constitution.

cross_references.description_zh: 李清照与苏轼是'以诗为词'的相反立场：苏轼把词当成诗的别调，以诗法入词、抬高词格，李清照在《词论》里点名批评这种做法是'句读不葺之诗'，坚持词须协音律、别是一家——对照命题：抬升一个文体的两条路——兼并（并入诗）与独立（划界自守）——而独立的宣言恰恰出自被兼并者的传统内部。
cross_references.description_en: Li Qingzhao and Su Shi stand opposed on 'taking ci as poetry': Su Shi treated ci as poetry's alter ego, importing poetic method to ennoble it; Li Qingzhao in the 'Ci Lun' named this practice 'shi with no regard for its own punctuation' and insisted ci must obey musical law and is a family of its own. The contrast thesis: two roads to ennobling a genre — annexation (merging it into poetry) and independence (drawing its borders) — and the declaration of independence came from within the tradition being annexed.

cross_references.description_zh: 李清照与董仲舒都做过'为丧失记账'与'为文体立法'的事：董仲舒在秦火之后为经典立制度和解释体系，李清照在靖康之变后为收藏立聚散的账目、为词体立独立的法度——平行命题：秩序的重建不发生在太平年月，而恰恰发生在劫火之后。
cross_references.description_en: Li Qingzhao and Dong Zhongshu both kept accounts of loss and legislated for a corpus: Dong Zhongshu, after the Qin burning, built the institutional and interpretive system for the classics; Li Qingzhao, after the Jingkang catastrophe, kept the ledger of her collection's scatter and gave the lyric its legal standing. The parallel thesis: the rebuilding of order happens not in years of peace but precisely after the fire.
